summary: Module 03 (en) QA done: check 0 errors/0 warnings; build and render clean (no console, KaTeX, image or widget errors); all 18 figures and both widgets match captions and text; the reviewer's three lab issues were fixed (Lab 3 and Lab 6 re-run and reconciled); one real build bug found and fixed (broken math in the page's learning outcomes).
changes: plan/module_03.json: outcomes[1], outcomes[2] and two session activity strings had LaTeX floor and 	imes written with single backslashes, which JSON decoded as a carriage return and a tab, so the 'By the end you can' list showed '/sfloor+1' and '1times1'. Escaped them; page now renders the floor formula and 1 x 1 correctly.

20-labs-a.md Lab 3 step 8: added a second loop that trains the plain 19- and 55-layer networks at peaks 0.03 and 0.02 (seed 0) and prints their loss and accuracy (0.93/0.64 and 1.66/0.32 at 0.03; 0.88/0.68 and 1.91/0.27 at 0.02); the prose now cites that printed output instead of 'separate runs'; run-time sentence updated to about two minutes desktop, three to four laptop. Re-run with --update; all earlier blocks still matched.
20-labs-a.md Lab 2 Try this 2 and 3: stated batch 32, seeds 0 to 2, 300 epochs and the evaluation set, and noted the accuracies move by a few points with the seed.
21-labs-b.md Lab 6 step 1: print now formats the class balance with .3f, output fence updated to 0.521 by re-running lab6 with --update (all blocks match).
issues: Not fixed, as the reviewer left it: 11-concepts-b/12 s13 ellipsoid example quotes 6,372 voxels without naming the sub-voxel offset (recomputed 6,369 to 6,371 depending on placement); plausible but not exactly reproducible. The same applies to the s10 quoted augmentation numbers (0.36 to 0.66, 0.76 to 0.90, 0.90 to 0.83): they are single-run figures and the reviewer's re-run gave 0.36 to 0.71 and 0.77 to 0.92, so only direction and size are reproducible; Lab 2 text now says so.
Lab 3 now takes longer by the four added plain-network runs; exact new time was not timed, the prose says about two minutes.

The two interactive widgets are known to zoom their views for large H (receptive-field-builder) and report unreliable changedOutput flags in widget-test; not changed. In element screenshots the sticky page header overlaps the top of some tall figures; this is a screenshot artefact, the figures themselves were checked in the page shots and are not clipped.
Chinese Module 03 plan strings were not touched; zh uses the English plan for structural fields, so the plan JSON fix also reaches zh.
